description: Ask whether a given company can be served — legal form, size class, fiscal year — answered by the production engine, with the reasons if not. This endpoint only answers questions about eBilanz Fabrik's products, prices and whether a company's legal form, size class and financial year are in scope. It prepares nothing, never files, never takes payment, and never accepts an ELSTER certificate or PIN.

groesse.description: size class per § 267/267a HGB — Kleinst, klein, mittelgross, gross (case does not matter)

rechtsform.description: legal form — GmbH, UG, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), AG, Aktiengesellschaft, SE, Societas Europaea, andere (case does not matter)

stichtag.description: REQUIRED — balance sheet date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-12-31. Omitting it makes the engine treat the year as abweichend and answer eligible=false.

name: ebf_check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility
